fev.translation: abbr. fever 发烧的; fevereiro (Portuguese=February) （葡萄牙语）二月; forced expiratory volume 强迫呼吸量; 用力呼气容积

fever.definition:
n. a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection
n. intense nervous anticipation
fever.translation:
n. 发烧, 发热, 热病
[医] 发热, 热

fever african tick.translation: [医] 非洲蜱传热, 非洲回归热

fever blister.translation: [医] 热病性疱疹, 单纯疱疹

fever therapy.translation: [医] 发热疗法, 魏斯氏疗法

fever treatment.translation: [医] 发热疗法, 治疗性发热; 热病治疗法

fevered.translation: a. 发烧的, 激动的, 激昂的

feverfew.definition: n. bushy aromatic European perennial herb having clusters of buttonlike white-rayed flower heads; valued traditionally for medicinal uses; sometimes placed in genus Chrysanthemum
feverfew.translation:
n. 小白菊
[医] 龙牙草, 野甘菊

fevering.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Fever
fevering.translation: vt. 引起发热（fever的现在分词形式）

feverish.definition:
s. marked by intense agitation or emotion
s. having or affected by a fever
feverish.translation: a. 发热的, 极度兴奋的, 不安的

feverishness.definition: n. a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection

feverous.definition: s having or affected by a fever
feverous.translation: a. 发烧的, 热病的

feverroot.definition: n. coarse weedy American perennial herb with large usually perfoliate leaves and purple or dull red flowers

fevers.definition:
n. a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection
n. intense nervous anticipation
fevers.translation: n. 热（病）( fever的复数形式 ); 发烧; 一时的狂热; 激动不安

feverwort.definition: n. See Fever root, under Fever.

fevold test.translation: [医] 费沃耳德氏试验(检弛缓素)
